query:
The family operates with an understanding that when Nkechi cooks for a gathering, everyone eats what she has prepared without requesting alternatives. Does this expectation apply to all family members equally? If not, who behaves differently, and what makes this visible without it becoming a conflict?

Options:
A. Emeka
B. Tobenna
C. Ifeoma
D. Chisom
context:
[1] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:11:00) My children. I will make egusi with stockfish. Ifeoma, I have remembered every year but it is good that you mentioned it. The menu is settled then: ofe onugbu, jollof, egusi with stockfish. Kingsley handles his suya outside. Adaeze brings chin chin and puff puff. 🙏
[2] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T17:49:00) My children. Kingsley the kitchen in this house is not a barbecue pit. But I will allow the suya if you keep the smoke outside. Adaeze, chin chin is expected, do not arrive without it. God willing, I have a full house this year. Oby, are you joining us from Enugu via video? 🙏
[3] (about=Chisom, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:09:00) Ifeoma I totally forgot!! okay SO Mum can you do a small pot of egusi with stockfish? that would sort Ifeoma and honestly I would also eat that 😭
[4] (about=Kingsley, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T17:46:00) hear me out. I am coming and I am bringing the suya. on God nobody is eating dry chicken on Christmas Day while I'm in the building. Aunty Nkechi I know you have the jollof covered but let me handle the meat. I'll bring my own grill if I have to 🔥
[5] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) My children, Oby is right to raise this now. I am hosting again as always. I will cook. We have always done Christmas at mine - your father set that tradition and I see no reason to change it. I expect everyone on 25th or 26th at the latest. God willing, I will have ofe onugbu and jollof rice ready as usual. 🙏
[6] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:08:00) My children, your Aunty Oby is speaking wisdom. And nobody thought to ask whether I need any help with the cooking this year? You know I will do it alone if nobody volunteers, but I will remember who did not ask. 🙂
[7] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:03:00) Chisom, I am glad you understand. This is a matter of how we have always operated as a family. Your grandfather insisted that when the family gathers, it gathers properly, all present, no distractions, the meal shared without rushing. That is what Christmas means in this family.
[8] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T18:48:00) Greetings. Adaeze. Thank you for saying this clearly. I have been waiting two years for you to stop saying it is fine. In our family, we have always believed that no one person should carry what belongs to everyone. Emeka has already offered. I suggest you formalise it this week. Do not leave it for January.
[9] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:29:00) okay so on it. I'll put together a running order: 1. Video call with Aunty Oby at 11am before food 2. Food from 2pm 3. Emeka's lot arriving by 12 based on his message. (no stress, I'll circulate it by Friday!) 😊
[10] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t4 @2025-11-02T18:17:00) Greetings my people. Emeka, this is good. Your grandfather always said that a man who makes himself available to his family is richer than one who merely provides for them. I am glad your daughter has spoken into you what we have hoped for.
agent_answer:
The expectation does **not** apply equally to all family members.

- **Ifeoma (C):** She is the one who “mentioned” wanting egusi with stockfish each year. Nkechi confirms, *“Ifeoma, I have remembered every year… the menu is settled… egusi with stockfish.”* So Ifeoma gets a specific dish made for her rather than simply eating whatever Nkechi had planned.
- **Chisom (D):** She explicitly requests an alternative when she says, *“Mum can you do a small pot of egusi with stockfish? that would sort Ifeoma and honestly I would also eat that.”* So Chisom also asks for a dish beyond the standard menu.

It stays conflict-free because Nkechi accommodates the request willingly — she simply adds the egusi with stockfish to the settled menu (ofe onugbu, jollof, egusi with stockfish). The visible sign is the extra pot on the menu year after year.

Neither **Emeka (A)** nor **Tobenna (B)** requests any alternative dish in the conversation.
